description: This file contains unit tests for the DurableSet class, which is a persistent set implementation in the Orleans framework. The tests cover basic set operations (Add, Remove, Contains), persistence, complex value handling, enumeration, large volume handling, set operations (union, intersection, difference), and clear functionality. The tests utilize Xunit and involve creating and simulating lifecycle operations of Orleans grains and storage systems.

classes.name: DurableSetTests
classes.description: Unit test class for DurableSet, covering various operations and behaviors for persistent sets in Orleans.

methods.name: DurableSet_BasicOperations_Test
methods.description: Tests the fundamental set operations such as add, remove, and duplicate prevention, and verifies persistence.

methods.name: DurableSet_Persistence_Test
methods.description: Validates that the set's state is properly persisted and can be recovered across system restarts or reconstructions.

methods.name: DurableSet_ComplexValues_Test
methods.description: Checks that sets can handle custom complex objects with proper equality semantics, maintaining uniqueness.

methods.name: DurableSet_Clear_Test
methods.description: Ensures the clear operation removes all items and is correctly journaled.

methods.name: DurableSet_Enumeration_Test
methods.description: Verifies enumeration support and conversion to other collections.

methods.name: DurableSet_LargeNumberOfItems_Test
methods.description: Performs a performance and correctness test with thousands of elements and confirms journaled persistence.

methods.name: DurableSet_SetOperations_Test
methods.description: Demonstrates performing set algebra operations like intersection, union, and difference.

methods.name: DurableSet_ExceptWith_Test
methods.description: Tests removing multiple items via ExceptWith and verifies the resulting set contents.
